subject: MSA + Order Form: priority lane, evidence owners, and next steps
messages:

Cc: Procurement Team <procure@astrolabs.com>

Subject: Intro + MSA/order form kickoff

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — Astro Labs is excited to move forward. Procurement asked me to open a single thread for contracting so we can track deliverables and owners. High level asks from our side:

- Receive your standard MSA and a completed order form draft with pricing buckets.
- Summary of security evidence (SOC 2 scope, data residency, encryption at rest/in transit).
- Estimated timeline for signature (we're targeting a 3-week window).

I've attached the initial order form template our legal team prefers (they like XLS). Could you loop in whoever will own the redline and the security evidence?

Thanks,

Hi Olivia — great to hear and congrats to the team. Looping in Marissa (commercial lead) to own the MSA/order form coordination and Kimberly to own the security evidence packet. Our proposed plan:

1) Commercial intake (Marissa) — we’ll send our standard MSA + a pre-filled order form by EOD 9/12 for your review. Please flag clauses you want prioritized (e.g., data residency, indemnity, termination).
2) Security packet (Kimberly) — will follow with SOC 2 scope, encryption details, and retention policy.
3) Owner assignments & timeline — aim to have first-pass redlines back within 5 business days; if your legal needs a faster cadence we can prioritize a "priority lane" for contract review with an agreed cutover for final signature.

Action items:
- Marissa: attach MSA + order form draft and call out clause variants.
- Kimberly: add SOC2 summary and evidence links.
- Olivia: confirm if Astro Labs requires EU-only residency or if US/EU split is acceptable.

Thanks — I’ll keep thread updates here so procurement has a single source of truth.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Intro + MSA/order form kickoff

Hi Olivia — attaching a pre-filled order form and our standard MSA (minor commercial placeholders filled). Quick notes for your team to consider during review:

- Pricing: included volume bands and a "burst capacity" option — we added an example monthly commit.
- SLA: our Dedicated offering has a 99.9% uptime SLA; if you need stricter targets we can surface options but they'd be tied to Dedicated/reserved capacity.
- Exhibits: we added an Exhibit A (billing contacts) and Exhibit B (data residency choices).

Please review the following clause priorities and confirm which to accelerate into the priority lane:
- Data residency (EU-only vs hybrid)
- IP carve-outs for embeddings/outputs
- Audit rights & breach notification timing

We want to keep the first-pass redline window to 5 business days. If you mark items as priority, we’ll route them to a fast-track queue and agree a short follow-up call.

Attachments: Redwood_MSA_v1.2.docx, OrderForm-Astrolabs-draft.xlsx

Marissa Cole
Commercial Contracts, Redwood Inference

Hi all — attaching a short SOC 2 summary and a link to our security evidence folder. High-level items included:

- SOC 2 Type II scope (data plane + control plane), last audit: 2026-06, report available under NDA.
- Encryption: TLS 1.2+ in transit, AES-256 at rest with KMS integrations.
- Data retention & deletion: default retention is 90 days for ephemeral inference logs; customer export + delete options available for Private deployments.
- Pen test summary and contact for compliance packet.

Link to evidence: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMsA_evidence (access by request)

Proposed evidence owners for this intake:
- Kimberly Park (security evidence owner) — will share SOC 2 digest and coordinate NDA/doc requests.
- Marissa Cole (commercial owner) — will own MSA redlines and signature path.

Next steps:
- Olivia: confirm residency preference and any additional compliance asks (e.g., HIPAA, regional data residency for EU).
- We will populate the HubSpot deal record with timeline and owners and open a DocuSign envelope once commercial redlines are settled.

Thanks,
Kimberly Park
Senior Security & Compliance Program Manager, Redwood Inference
